Sample from the Dirichlet distribution

Source: R/generators.R
rdirichlet.Rd

Sample from the Dirichlet distribution

Usage

rdirichlet(n, alpha, k = NULL)

Arguments

n

Number of samples (rows) to draw

alpha

Concentration parameters; either length 1 or length > 1 If length 1, assumes symmetric Dirichlet; k must not be null

k

Number of components (columns); ignored if length(alpha) > 1

Value

A matrix of n rows and length(alpha) or k columns

See also

Other generators: draw_corpus(), journal_specific(), peak_alpha()

Examples

  rdirichlet(10, .1, 5)
#>               [,1]         [,2]         [,3]         [,4]         [,5]

#>  [3,] 2.329585e-02 1.409179e-19 8.873328e-01 6.110969e-07 8.937078e-02
#>  [4,] 9.909146e-01 2.356654e-09 1.369088e-08 9.083787e-03 1.624780e-06
#>  [5,] 4.908405e-02 8.272385e-01 3.162313e-03 1.152631e-01 5.252029e-03
#>  [6,] 1.060480e-01 6.778384e-05 8.081440e-01 8.489166e-02 8.485468e-04
#>  [7,] 4.082384e-01 2.796672e-01 1.590733e-01 1.530211e-01 1.057206e-12
